  title: "L1vsRA ChIPAnno"
author: "Julianne (Yulia) Murthy and SM"
date: "2026-05-12"

Goal: this script serves to perform ChIPAnno analysis on CUT&Tag data and RNA-Seq data as an alternative to BETA. To see if there is an association between G4 presence/lack thereof and changes in transcription

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# INSTALL DEPENDENCIES
```{r}
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(version = "3.20")

renv::install(c(
  "YuLab-SMU/GOSemSim",
```

# LOAD LIBRARIES
```{r}
library(ChIPseeker)
library(ChIPpeakAnno)
library(TxDb.Celegans.UCSC.ce11.refGene)
library(org.Ce.eg.db)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(RSQLite)
library(txdbmaker)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```


# PATHS
```{r}
# TxDb for C. elegans 
txdb <- TxDb.Celegans.UCSC.ce11.refGene
transcripts(txdb)

# Prep TxDb filter for NM (protein coding) transcripts
db_conn <- dbconn(txdb)

nm_tx  <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "transcript")
nm_tx  <- nm_tx[grepl("^NM_", nm_tx$tx_name), ]
nm_tx <- nm_tx %>% rename(tx_id = X_tx_id)
nm_ids <- nm_tx$tx_id

splicings_raw <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "splicing") %>% 
  rename(
    tx_id   = X_tx_id,
    exon_id = X_exon_id,
    cds_id  = X_cds_id
  )
genes_raw     <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "gene") %>% rename(tx_id = `X_tx_id`)
exons_raw <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "exon") %>% rename(exon_id = X_exon_id)
cds_raw <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "cds") %>% rename(cds_id = X_cds_id)

splicings_full <- splicings_raw %>%
  left_join(exons_raw[, c("exon_id", "exon_start", "exon_end")], by = "exon_id") %>%
  left_join(cds_raw[, c("cds_id", "cds_start", "cds_end")],     by = "cds_id")

chrominfo_raw <- dbReadTable(db_conn, "chrominfo")
chrominfo_raw$is_circular <- as.logical(chrominfo_raw$is_circular)

# Filter TxDb based on NM transcripts (aka protein coding transcripts) using SQL connection
txdb_nm <- makeTxDb(
  transcripts = nm_tx,
  splicings   = splicings_full %>% filter(tx_id %in% nm_ids),
  genes       = genes_raw     %>% filter(tx_id %in% nm_ids),
  chrominfo   = chrominfo_raw[, c("chrom", "length", "is_circular")]
)  

# Annotation source check
columns(org.Ce.eg.db)
head(keys(org.Ce.eg.db, keytype = "REFSEQ"), 20)

# BED file locations on hpc
bed_dir <- "/projects/daylab/yulia/ChIPseeker/chipseeker_infiles/L1vsRA_ChIPseeker"

# Output directory 
out_dir <- "/projects/daylab/yulia/ChIPseeker/chipseeker_outfiles/L1vsRA_ChIPAnno"

# input filenames - this time using peaks unique to L1 and RA
file_L1 <- file.path(bed_dir, "L1_HQfinal_unique.bed")
file_RA <- file.path(bed_dir, "RepAd_HQfinal_unique.bed")

# DESEQ SIGNIFICANT results
deseq <- read.csv(file.path(bed_dir, "DESeq2_L1vsRA_significant_genes.csv"))

```


# READ IN PEAK FILES
```{r}
peakL1 <- readPeakFile(file_L1)
peakRA <- readPeakFile(file_RA)

cat("L1 peaks:  ", length(peakL1), "\n") #2143
cat("RA peaks:", length(peakRA), "\n") #5923
```


# ANNOTATE PEAKS
## For C. elegans it appears +/- 3kb is correct, see Hunt-Newbury et al 2007 and Saito et al 2013; longest promoter studied appears to be ~2700bp
```{r}
# Extract transcripts and gene feature
annoData <- toGRanges(txdb_nm, feature = "gene")

# L1 ChipAnno peaks, with flanking genes added as well
peakAnnoL1 <- annotatePeakInBatch(
  peakL1,
  AnnotationData      = annoData,
  output              = "both",
  maxgap              = 3000,
  PeakLocForDistance  = "middle",
  FeatureLocForDistance = "TSS"   
)

# RA ChipAnno peaks, with flanking genes added as well
peakAnnoRA <- annotatePeakInBatch(
  peakRA,
  AnnotationData      = annoData,
  output              = "both",
  maxgap              = 3000,
  PeakLocForDistance  = "middle",
  FeatureLocForDistance = "TSS"
)

# Add gene symbols with org.Ce.eg.db
peakAnnoL1 <- addGeneIDs(peakAnnoL1,
                          orgAnn   = "org.Ce.eg.db",
                          feature_id_type = "entrez_id",
                          IDs2Add  = c("symbol","genename"))

peakAnnoRA <- addGeneIDs(peakAnnoRA,
                          orgAnn   = "org.Ce.eg.db",
                          feature_id_type = "entrez_id",
                          IDs2Add  = c("symbol","genename"))



```


# EXPORT FULL ANNOTATION CSVs
```{r}
# Convert to data frames
dfL1 <- as.data.frame(peakAnnoL1)  

dfRA <- as.data.frame(peakAnnoRA)

# Write full annotation CSVs
write.csv(dfL1, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnnoL1_full.csv"),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dfRA, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnnoRA_full.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
hist(dfRA$distancetoFeature, breaks = 50,

```


# FILTER FOR PROMOTER PEAKS 
```{r}

# Bin by promoter distance categories
bin_peaks <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(abs(distancetoFeature) <= 3000) %>%
    mutate(promoter_bin = case_when(
      abs(distancetoFeature) <= 1000                                  ~ "Promoter (<=1kb)",
      abs(distancetoFeature) >  1000 & abs(distancetoFeature) <= 2000 ~ "Promoter (1-2kb)",
      abs(distancetoFeature) >  2000 & abs(distancetoFeature) <= 3000 ~ "Promoter (2-3kb)"
    ))
}

promL1 <- bin_peaks(dfL1)
promRA <- bin_peaks(dfRA)

print(table(promL1$promoter_bin))
print(table(promRA$promoter_bin))
cat("L1 promoter peaks:  ", nrow(promL1), "/", nrow(dfL1), "\n") #2181 / 4208
cat("RA promoter peaks:", nrow(promRA), "/", nrow(dfRA), "\n") #7399 / 12506

```


# WRITE THE PROMOTER FILTERED CSVs
```{r}
write.csv(promL1, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnnoL1_promoter.csv"),    row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(promRA, file = file.path(out_dir, "peakAnnoRA_promoter.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```


# INNERJOIN SIG DEGs & PROMOTER G4s
```{r}
# No header on original deseq file, add in SYMBOL column to join later
colnames(deseq)[1] <- "SYMBOL"

# Rename symbol column to match deseq
promL1 <- promL1 %>% rename(SYMBOL = symbol)
promRA <- promRA %>% rename(SYMBOL = symbol)

# Flag whether the matched gene was nearest TSS or flanking
promL1 <- promL1 %>%
  group_by(peak) %>%
  mutate(association_type = ifelse(abs(distancetoFeature) == min(abs(distancetoFeature)),
                                   "nearest_TSS", "flanking")) %>%
  ungroup()
print(table(promL1$association_type))
promRA <- promRA %>%
  group_by(peak) %>%
  mutate(association_type = ifelse(abs(distancetoFeature) == min(abs(distancetoFeature)),
                                   "nearest_TSS", "flanking")) %>%
  ungroup()
print(table(promRA$association_type))

# Use inner_join() function to match G4 peaks within 3kb of the TSS (“promoter” G4s) to differentially expressed gene
G4_DEG_L1 <- inner_join(promL1, deseq, by = "SYMBOL")
G4_DEG_RA <- inner_join(promRA, deseq, by = "SYMBOL")

# Check how many genes overlapped
cat("L1 promoter G4s with DE genes:", nrow(G4_DEG_L1), "\n") #818
cat("RA promoter G4s with DE genes:", nrow(G4_DEG_RA), "\n")  #3511

# Export to CSV
write.csv(G4_DEG_L1, file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_L1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(G4_DEG_RA, file.path(out_dir, "G4_DEG_overlap_RA.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# G4 DEG flanking vs nearest TSS proportions

    units = "in", res = 300)

pie1(table(G4_DEG_RA$insideFeature), main = "RA G4 DEG Overlap Features")

# Look at chromosome distributions
pie1(table(G4_DEG_L1$seqnames), main = "L1 G4 DEG Chromosome Location")
pie1(table(G4_DEG_RA$seqnames), main = "RA G4 DEG Chromosome Location")

# Of those flanking vs TSS nearest , what features are shown?
pie1(table(G4_DEG_L1 %>% filter(association_type == "nearest_TSS") %>% pull(insideFeature)),
     main = "L1 Nearest TSS")
pie1(table(G4_DEG_L1 %>% filter(association_type == "flanking")    %>% pull(insideFeature)),
     main = "L1 Flanking")
pie1(table(G4_DEG_RA %>% filter(association_type == "nearest_TSS") %>% pull(insideFeature)),
     main = "RA Nearest TSS")
pie1(table(G4_DEG_RA %>% filter(association_type == "flanking")    %>% pull(insideFeature)),
     main = "RA Flanking")


```
